description: Loads the master data that a loaded sheet refers to (assets, locations and so on), limited to **the values that appear in that sheet**, and shows it next to that sheet as a related sheet. Examples: the assets referred to by ASSETNUM in multi-asset rows, or the locations referred to by a work order's LOCATION. When a column you are fixing refers to another table, always load that table with this first (it also appears side by side on screen). If there are too many distinct values, narrow the source sheet first.

from.description: Column in the source sheet (children as MULTIASSETLOCCI.ASSETNUM)

name.description: Name of the new sheet (e.g. Assets)

os.description: Object structure of the master data (e.g. MXAPIASSET)

select.description: Columns of the master data (key columns are added automatically)

to.description: Match column in the master data (e.g. ASSETNUM)

where.description: Extra conditions on the master data (e.g. SITEID) (default [])

attr.description: Attribute or column name. Join child attributes with a dot, e.g. EXT_WOPERMIT.EXT_PERMITDATE

name: load_master
title: Load referenced master data
